name: Thailand
tagline: Limestone karsts, long-tail boats and night markets, four hours from Delhi.
flightFromIndia: 4 h from Delhi or Mumbai, 3 h 30 m from Kolkata

visa.type: Visa-free entry + Thailand Digital Arrival Card (TDAC)

name: Sri Lanka
tagline: Rock fortresses, tea hills and the slowest, prettiest train ride in Asia.
flightFromIndia: 1 h 15 m from Chennai, 1 h from Kochi or Thiruvananthapuram

name: Vietnam
tagline: Karst bays, lantern towns and the best ₹150 bowl of noodles you will ever eat.
flightFromIndia: 4 h direct from Delhi or Mumbai to Hanoi or Ho Chi Minh City

visa.govFee: US$25 single entry, US$50 multiple entry

name: Iceland
tagline: Waterfalls, black-sand beaches and glaciers, on one road around an island.
flightFromIndia: No direct flights: about 14–18 h via a European hub

visa.type: Schengen short-stay visa (type C) via VFS Global

name: Singapore
tagline: A clean, compact city-state of gardens, hawker food and theme parks, five hours from India.
flightFromIndia: About 4 h 30 m from Chennai, 5 h 30 m from Delhi or Mumbai

visa.type: Visa required (via an authorised agent) + SG Arrival Card
visa.stay: Set by the visit pass issued at the checkpoint
visa.govFee: Not stated by ICA; set by the visa agent
visa.processing: Ask the agent; SG Arrival Card within 3 days before arrival

name: Bhutan
tagline: A Himalayan kingdom of dzongs and cliffside monasteries that Indians can enter without a visa.
flightFromIndia: About 45 min to 2 h from Bagdogra, Kolkata, Guwahati or Delhi to Paro

visa.type: No visa; entry permit with Indian passport or voter ID, plus the Sustainable Development Fee
visa.stay: Set by the permit (the official FAQ gives up to 90 days for visas)
visa.govFee: SDF Nu 1,200 (₹1,200) per adult per night; ₹600 for ages 6–11; free under 6
visa.processing: Apply online before travel, or at the point of entry (may involve a wait)
